info.title: Tambo API
info.description:
Anti-theft backend: auth (email OTP), devices, evidence ingest, theft episodes, location trail, buddies, legal acceptance, and the signed evidence pack.

**Error contract**: every non-2xx response is `{ code, message }` (schema `Error`). Branch on `code`, never on `message` - messages are wording and will change; codes are contract.

**Legacy alias**: every `/api/v1/auth/*` path is also served at `/api/auth/*` for pre-OpenAPI mobile builds; new clients use the versioned paths.

post.summary: Ingest a batch of evidence envelopes (idempotent per envelope id)
post.description: Authenticates as a DEVICE via X-Device-Token. 200 even with per-envelope rejections: read the ACK list; retry only failures. An ingest response carrying episodeId/episodeOpened is the cue to start the location-trail fan-out.

parameters.description: The one-shot ingest token issued at device registration.

episodeId.description: Present when the device has an open episode after this batch.

episodeOpened.description: True when THIS batch crossed the threshold. Start the trail.
